summary: Permanent audit trail + closure outcomes (Ed 2026-10-24). Creates the canonical append-only audit_events table (service_role SELECT/INSERT only; a trigger rejects UPDATE, DELETE and TRUNCATE), adds nullable closure columns to violations (closure_outcome, closure_reason, duplicate_of_violation_id, closed_by_user_id, stage_at_closure) with CHECKs that keep resolved_via compatible, a trigger that makes stage_at_closure immutable except an audited reopen, and close_violation_with_audit() (service_role only) that closes a case, writes its audit event and its timeline note in one transaction. No existing row is changed or backfilled: every existing closed case keeps closure_outcome NULL (legacy, unclassified).

preflight.name: audit_events does not exist yet
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'audit_events'

preflight.name: the closure columns do not exist yet
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'violations' AND column_name IN ('closure_outcome','closure_reason','duplicate_of_violation_id','closed_by_user_id','stage_at_closure')

preflight.name: violations.resolved_via still allows cured, withdrawn and voided
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid = 'public.violations'::regclass AND contype = 'c' AND pg_get_constraintdef(oid) ILIKE '%resolved_via%' AND pg_get_constraintdef(oid) ILIKE '%cured%' AND pg_get_constraintdef(oid) ILIKE '%withdrawn%' AND pg_get_constraintdef(oid) ILIKE '%voided%'

preflight.name: user_profiles exists (actor foreign key)
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'user_profiles'

expected_changes: New table audit_events (empty), RLS on, service_role SELECT + INSERT only; UPDATE/DELETE/TRUNCATE revoked and blocked by triggers trg_audit_events_append_only and trg_audit_events_no_truncate.

violations: five new nullable columns with no default; CHECKs violations_closure_outcome_check, violations_closure_coherent, violations_duplicate_survivor; FKs to violations(id) and user_profiles(id), ON DELETE RESTRICT; two partial indexes.
violations: trigger trg_violations_stage_at_closure_guard (BEFORE UPDATE) protects stage_at_closure.
Function close_violation_with_audit(...) executable by service_role only.
No row changes in any table; no backfill; every existing closed case keeps closure_outcome NULL.

verify.name: service_role can read and append audit_events
service_role cannot rewrite or erase audit_events
anon and authenticated have no access to audit_events

verify.name: the three guard triggers are present
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_trigger WHERE NOT tgisinternal AND tgname IN ('trg_audit_events_append_only','trg_audit_events_no_truncate','trg_violations_stage_at_closure_guard')
